eligibilityCriterionItems.name: Age requirement
eligibilityCriterionItems.text: Participants aged ≥18 at the time of signing the ICF.

eligibilityCriterionItems.name: Diagnosis of Wilson Disease
eligibilityCriterionItems.text: Diagnosis of WD by Leipzig Criteria ≥ 4 documented by testing as outlined in the 2012 European Association for the Study of Liver WD Clinical Practice Guidelines (Ferenci, 2003; EASL, 2012) or by historical test results for WD including some or all of the following: Presence of Kayser Fleischer rings, Neurological symptoms, Serum ceruloplasmin below reference range, Coombs_negative hemolytic anemia, Elevated liver or urinary copper, Presence of mutations in the ATP7B gene, or Other, as considered appropriate, may be used instead to confirm the diagnosis of WD.

eligibilityCriterionItems.name: Potential benefit from decoppering therapy
eligibilityCriterionItems.text: Participants who in the opinion of the referring Investigator may benefit from decoppering therapy.

eligibilityCriterionItems.name: Compliance with study procedures
eligibilityCriterionItems.text: Participants must be able to comply with all study_related procedures.

eligibilityCriterionItems.name: Able to reside in the CRU
eligibilityCriterionItems.text: Participants must be able to reside in the CRU for intensive metabolic monitoring of copper and molybdenum.

eligibilityCriterionItems.name: Willing to discontinue chelator therapy
eligibilityCriterionItems.text: Participants willing to discontinue chelator therapy for approximately 4 days prior to initiation of ALXN1840 to allow a baseline assessment of copper balance.

eligibilityCriterionItems.name: Adequate venous access
eligibilityCriterionItems.text: Participants with adequate venous access to allow collection of required blood samples.

eligibilityCriterionItems.name: Able to swallow tablets
eligibilityCriterionItems.text: Participants must be able to swallow intact ALXN1840 tablets.

eligibilityCriterionItems.name: Avoidance of copper, zinc, or molybdenum minerals
eligibilityCriterionItems.text: Participants willing to avoid use of minerals containing copper, zinc, or molybdenum throughout the study duration.

eligibilityCriterionItems.name: Adherence to controlled diet
eligibilityCriterionItems.text: Participants willing to adhere to copper/molybdenum_controlled diet during inpatient periods and willing to comply with a low copper dietary requirement during the Outpatient Period.

eligibilityCriterionItems.name: Contraceptive requirements
eligibilityCriterionItems.text: Contraceptive use by men or women should be consistent with local regulations regarding the methods of contraception for those participating in clinical studies. a. Male participants: Male participants, if heterosexually active and with a female spouse or partner of childbearing potential or a pregnant or breastfeeding spouse or partner, must agree to use barrier contraception (male condom) for the duration of the study and for at least 3 months after the end of systemic exposure of the study intervention. Male participants must not donate sperm for at least 3 months after the end of systemic exposure of the study intervention. Female spouses or partners of male participants who are of childbearing potential must use highly effective contraception as defined below and in Section 10.4, starting at least 1 menstrual cycle before (the male participant's) first study intervention administration and continuing until at least 3 months after the end of their male partner's systemic exposure to the study intervention. Barrier contraception (male condom) is required even with documented medical assessment of surgical success of a vasectomy. For male participants who have had a vasectomy (with documented evidence of azoospermia if possible) and agree to use a male condom for the stated time period, no additional contraceptive method is required by their female partner. b. Female participants: Female participants or female partners of male participants of childbearing potential (including breastfeeding females), if heterosexually active, must be willing to follow protocol_specified contraception guidance starting at least 1 menstrual cycle before first study intervention administration and continuing for at least 3 months after the end of systemic exposure of the study intervention. Female participants must not donate ova for at least 3 months after the end of systemic exposure of the study intervention. Female participants who are documented as being of non_childbearing potential as defined in Section 10.4 are exempt from contraception requirements. Highly effective contraceptive methods for female participants and female partners of male participants are described in Section 10.4.

eligibilityCriterionItems.name: Informed consent
eligibilityCriterionItems.text: Participants capable of giving signed informed consent, which includes compliance with the requirements and restrictions listed in the ICF and in this protocol.

eligibilityCriterionItems.name: Decompensated cirrhosis or high MELD score
eligibilityCriterionItems.text: Decompensated cirrhosis or model for end_stage liver disease (MELD) score > 13.

eligibilityCriterionItems.name: Modified Nazer score
eligibilityCriterionItems.text: Modified Nazer score > 7 (Dhawan, 2005).

eligibilityCriterionItems.name: Recent gastrointestinal bleed
eligibilityCriterionItems.text: Clinically significant gastrointestinal bleed within past 3 months.

eligibilityCriterionItems.name: Elevated ALT
eligibilityCriterionItems.text: Alanine aminotransferase (ALT) > 2 × upper limit of normal (ULN).

eligibilityCriterionItems.name: Marked neurological disease
eligibilityCriterionItems.text: Marked neurological disease requiring assistance with self_care or activities of daily life.

eligibilityCriterionItems.name: Low hemoglobin
eligibilityCriterionItems.text: Hemoglobin less than lower limit of the reference range for age and sex.

eligibilityCriterionItems.name: Active hepatitis B or C or HIV seropositivity
eligibilityCriterionItems.text: Active infection with hepatitis B virus (positive hepatitis B surface antigen) or C virus (participants with positive hepatitis C antibody result would require confirmation of active disease with a positive hepatitis C polymerase chain reaction test), or seropositivity for human immunodeficiency virus (HIV).

eligibilityCriterionItems.name: Significant history of systemic or psychiatric disorders
eligibilityCriterionItems.text: History or presence of/significant history of or current cardiovascular, respiratory, hepatic, renal, gastrointestinal, endocrinological, hematological, or neurological disorders, or psychiatric disorder that in the opinion of the Investigator may constitute a risk when taking the study intervention; or may interfere with the interpretation of data.

eligibilityCriterionItems.name: Previous ALXN1840 or tetrathiomolybdate treatment
eligibilityCriterionItems.text: Previous treatment with ALXN1840 or other form of tetrathiomolybdate within 1 year prior to dosing.

eligibilityCriterionItems.name: Previous zinc treatment
eligibilityCriterionItems.text: Previous treatment with zinc within 21 days prior to Day 1.

eligibilityCriterionItems.name: Use of experimental or unapproved therapy
eligibilityCriterionItems.text: The use of an experimental or unapproved/unlicensed therapy at the same time or within 90 days or 5 half_lives, whichever is longer, prior to the Screening Visit.

eligibilityCriterionItems.name: Renal failure
eligibilityCriterionItems.text: Participants in renal failure, defined as in end_stage renal disease on dialysis (chronic kidney disease [CKD] stage 5) or creatinine clearance < 30 mL/min (Levey, 2006).

eligibilityCriterionItems.name: Pregnancy or breastfeeding
eligibilityCriterionItems.text: Pregnant (or females who are planning to become pregnant) or breastfeeding females (women of childbearing potential must have a negative serum pregnancy test result at screening).

eligibilityCriterionItems.name: Known sensitivity to ALXN1840 or excipients
eligibilityCriterionItems.text: Known sensitivity to ALXN1840, ALXN1840 excipients (anhydrous dicalcium phosphate, anhydrous sodium carbonate), or any of the ingredients contained in ALXN1840 or related compounds.

eligibilityCriterionItems.name: Likely non_compliance
eligibilityCriterionItems.text: In the opinion of the Investigator, the participant and/or their legal guardian is likely to be non_compliant or uncooperative during the study.

eligibilityCriterionItems.name: Drug or alcohol abuse history
eligibilityCriterionItems.text: History of illicit drug abuse, history of significant alcohol abuse within 1 year prior to the Screening Visit, or clinical evidence of substance and/or alcohol abuse within the 2 years before screening. Alcohol abuse is defined as regular weekly intake of more than 14 units (for both males and females), using the following National Health Service (NHS) alcohol tracker http://www.nhs.uk/Tools/Pages/drinks_tracker.aspx.

eligibilityCriterionItems.name: Positive urine drug toxicology screen
eligibilityCriterionItems.text: Positive urine drug toxicology screen at Screening or on Day _8 (cannabinoids will not be tested).

eligibilityCriterionItems.name: Recent alcohol consumption or positive breath test
eligibilityCriterionItems.text: Alcohol consumption within 48 hours prior to study intervention administration or positive alcohol breath test at screening or on Day _8.

eligibilityCriterionItems.name: Unwilling to complete controlled menu meals
eligibilityCriterionItems.text: Participants unwilling to consistently complete every meal and tolerate a controlled, limited menu for the duration of the study.

arms.name: ALXN1840 Treatment
arms.description: Single_arm, open_label, repeat_dose ALXN1840 (bis_choline tetrathiomolybdate) administered orally once daily; all participants start at 15 mg/day for approximately 28 days and are then titrated up to 30 mg/day on Day 29 following Safety Review Committee review of safety data through Day 23. Participants may remain on 15 mg/day for the duration of the study if safety concerns arise.

objectives.name: Primary Objective
objectives.text: Assess net copper balance with daily repeat_dose ALXN1840 treatment (15 mg and 30 mg) in participants with Wilson disease (WD)

endpoints.name: Primary Endpoint
endpoints.text: Mean daily copper balance where copper balance is measured by the calculated difference between copper intake (in food and drink) and copper output (in feces and urine) during ALXN1840 accumulation and steady_state periods for each dose

objectives.name: Secondary Objective 1
objectives.text: Assess change in copper balance in response to ALXN1840 15 mg/day and 30 mg/day during ALXN1840 accumulation and at steady state periods versus the pretreatment baseline in participants with WD

endpoints.name: Secondary Endpoint 1
endpoints.text: Change in mean daily copper balance as measured by the calculated difference between copper intake (in food and drink) and copper output (in feces and urine) from pretreatment baseline (Days _4 through _1) and ALXN1840 accumulation and steady_state periods for each dose

objectives.name: Secondary Objective 2
objectives.text: Investigate the effect of ALXN1840 (15 mg/day and 30 mg/day) on the disposition of copper in participants with WD

endpoints.name: Secondary Endpoint 2
endpoints.text: Copper quantified in food, drink, feces, and urine, including plasma total and labile bound copper (LBC) during ALXN1840 accumulation and steady_state periods for each dose

objectives.name: Secondary Objective 3
objectives.text: Investigate the effect of ALXN1840 on the disposition of molybdenum at steady state at 15 mg/day and 30 mg/day in participants with WD

endpoints.name: Secondary Endpoint 3
endpoints.text: Molybdenum quantified in food, drink, feces, and urine, plasma total molybdenum at ALXN1840 steady state

objectives.name: Secondary Objective 4
objectives.text: Assess steady_state total molybdenum balance as a measure of ALXN1840 15 mg/day and 30 mg/day in participants with WD

endpoints.name: Secondary Endpoint 4
endpoints.text: Mean daily molybdenum balance as demonstrated through measurement of molybdenum intake (in food, drink and ALXN1840), and molybdenum output (feces and urine) representing ALXN1840 steady state

objectives.name: Secondary Objective 5
objectives.text: Assess accumulation of molybdenum with ALXN1840 treatment at 15 mg/day and 30 mg/day in participants with WD

endpoints.name: Secondary Endpoint 5
endpoints.text: Accumulation of molybdenum as determined by molybdenum balance

objectives.name: Secondary Objective 6
objectives.text: Determine the steady_state plasma pharmacokinetic (PK) of total molybdenum and plasma ultrafiltrate (PUF) molybdenum (as surrogate measures of ALXN1840, 15 mg and 30 mg) in participants with WD

endpoints.name: Secondary Endpoint 6
endpoints.text: PK parameters for plasma total and PUF_molybdenum

objectives.name: Safety Objective
objectives.text: Evaluate the safety and tolerability of repeated_dose administration of ALXN1840 15 mg/day and 30 mg/day in participants with WD

endpoints.name: Safety Endpoint
endpoints.text: Safety parameters: Treatment emergent adverse events (TEAEs)/serious adverse events (SAEs); Clinical laboratory assessments (serum chemistry, hematology, coagulation, and urinalysis); Physical examinations; Heart rate, intervals (PR, QRS, QT and QTc), and clinically significant electrocardiogram (ECG) findings as determined by triplicate 12_lead ECG; Vital sign assessments (blood pressure and heart rate)

objectives.name: Exploratory Objective 1
objectives.text: Determine dose response of ALXN1840 15 mg/day and 30 mg/day for copper balance in participants with WD

endpoints.name: Exploratory Endpoint 1
endpoints.text: Assess dose response of ALXN1840 on copper balance focusing on copper balance

objectives.name: Exploratory Objective 2
objectives.text: Determine the effect of treatment duration on copper balance in participants with WD

endpoints.name: Exploratory Endpoint 2
endpoints.text: Determine the effect of time following initiation of ALXN1840 treatment on copper balance

objectives.name: Exploratory Objective 3
objectives.text: Assess the effects of ALXN1840 on ceruloplasmin, ceruloplasmin_bound copper LBC profiles in plasma in participants with WD

endpoints.name: Exploratory Endpoint 3
endpoints.text: Ceruloplasmin, ceruloplasmin_bound copper, and LBC: Change in ceruloplasmin at Days 1, 8, 25, 29, 36, and Day 39 compared with predose

estimands.name: Primary Estimand _ Net Copper Balance with ALXN1840 15 mg and 30 mg
estimands.populationSummary: Adult participants with confirmed Wilson disease meeting all eligibility criteria, admitted to a clinical research unit on a copper_controlled diet, previously treated with chelator therapy (discontinued approximately 4 days prior to Day 1) and off zinc therapy for at least 21 days (Full Analysis Set (all enrolled participants who received at least 1 dose of ALXN1840 and have evaluable copper intake/output collections); no comparator arm (single_arm, open_label, within_participant dose comparison)) Summary measure: Descriptive summary statistics (n, arithmetic mean, standard deviation, median, minimum, maximum) of mean daily copper balance by dose level and collection period, with proportion of participants achieving net negative copper balance.

intercurrentEvents.name: Failure to escalate to 30 mg/day due to safety concerns
intercurrentEvents.text: Per adaptive protocol features, participants may remain on ALXN1840 15 mg/day for the duration of the study if the Investigator and/or Alexion judge that escalation to 30 mg/day may place the participant at undue risk; such participants contribute data only to the 15 mg/day dose periods and are summarized according to the dose actually received

intercurrentEvents.name: Dose reduction or dose interruption
intercurrentEvents.text: ALXN1840 dose is decreased (to as low as 15 mg every other day) or interrupted because dose modification criteria are met; all available copper balance data are analyzed as observed under the actual dose administered

intercurrentEvents.name: Permanent discontinuation of study intervention or withdrawal from study
intercurrentEvents.text: Participant permanently discontinues ALXN1840 or withdraws before completing all collection periods; observed collection_period data up to discontinuation are included and no imputation is performed

intercurrentEvents.name: Use of prohibited copper_modifying therapy (chelator or zinc)
intercurrentEvents.text: Reinitiation of chelator therapy or zinc as rescue/background therapy during the study would confound copper balance; copper balance is estimated as if the prohibited therapy had not been used (affected collection periods excluded from the primary analysis)

intercurrentEvents.name: Incomplete diet control or incomplete urine/feces collection
intercurrentEvents.text: Non_adherence to the copper_controlled diet (including during the Outpatient Period, Day 9 to Day 23) or incomplete/invalid 24_hour urine or fecal collections; balance is estimated as if complete collection and diet control had occurred, with non_evaluable collection periods excluded

estimands.name: Secondary Estimand _ Change in Mean Daily Copper Balance from Pretreatment Baseline
estimands.populationSummary: Adult participants with Wilson disease with an evaluable pretreatment baseline copper balance collection (Days _4 through _1, off chelator) and at least one on_treatment collection period (Full Analysis Set (participants with evaluable baseline and at least one post_baseline copper balance assessment); within_participant comparison versus pretreatment baseline) Summary measure: Descriptive summary of within_participant mean change (and percent change) from pretreatment baseline in mean daily copper balance by dose and collection period.

intercurrentEvents.name: Failure to escalate to 30 mg/day
intercurrentEvents.text: Participant remains on 15 mg/day for the duration of the study due to safety concerns; change from baseline is summarized by dose actually received

intercurrentEvents.name: Dose reduction, interruption, or treatment discontinuation
intercurrentEvents.text: Dose modification or premature discontinuation of ALXN1840; all observed on_treatment change_from_baseline data are included as observed

intercurrentEvents.name: Reinitiation of chelator or zinc therapy (Secondary Estimand _ Change in Mean Daily Copper Balance from Pretreatment Baseline)
intercurrentEvents.text: Use of prohibited copper_modifying therapy during the study; change from baseline estimated as if such therapy had not been taken

intercurrentEvents.name: Missing or invalid baseline collection
intercurrentEvents.text: Pretreatment baseline collection (Days _4 through _1) not evaluable due to incomplete collection or diet non_adherence; participant excluded from the change_from_baseline analysis as if the event had not occurred

estimands.name: Secondary Estimand _ Copper Disposition (Food, Drink, Feces, Urine, Plasma Total Copper and LBC)
estimands.populationSummary: Adult participants with Wilson disease receiving ALXN1840 under controlled dietary conditions in a clinical research unit (Full Analysis Set (all participants who received at least 1 dose of ALXN1840 with evaluable copper disposition samples)) Summary measure: Descriptive summary statistics (mean, SD, median, range) of copper concentrations/amounts by matrix, dose level, and collection period; changes from pretreatment baseline summarized descriptively.

intercurrentEvents.name: Dose modification or non_escalation to 30 mg/day (Secondary Estimand _ Copper Disposition (Food, Drink, Feces, Urine, Plasma Total Copper and LBC))
intercurrentEvents.text: Dose reduction, interruption, or continuation at 15 mg/day instead of escalation; data summarized according to the dose actually received

intercurrentEvents.name: Premature treatment discontinuation
intercurrentEvents.text: Participant discontinues ALXN1840 before completing all collection periods; only data collected while on treatment are summarized

intercurrentEvents.name: Incomplete sample collection or diet deviation
intercurrentEvents.text: Incomplete 24_hour urine/fecal collections, duplicate diet sample loss, or deviation from the copper_controlled diet; affected periods excluded and results estimated as if complete collection had occurred

estimands.name: Secondary Estimand _ Molybdenum Disposition at Steady State
estimands.populationSummary: Adult participants with Wilson disease receiving ALXN1840 at predicted steady state for the 15 mg/day and 30 mg/day doses (Full Analysis Set / Molybdenum Mass Balance Analysis Set (participants with evaluable molybdenum intake and output collections at steady state)) Summary measure: Descriptive summary statistics of molybdenum amounts by matrix and dose level at steady state; percent of administered dose recovered in urine and feces.

intercurrentEvents.name: Steady state not achieved due to dose modification or interruption
intercurrentEvents.text: Dose reduction or interruption prevents attainment of predicted steady state during the collection period; data are analyzed as observed according to actual dosing

intercurrentEvents.name: Treatment discontinuation before steady_state collection
intercurrentEvents.text: Participant discontinues ALXN1840 prior to the steady_state molybdenum collection period; only on_treatment data are summarized

intercurrentEvents.name: Incomplete urine/fecal collection
intercurrentEvents.text: Incomplete or lost excreta collections during the mass balance period; the estimate is derived as if complete collection had been obtained (non_evaluable periods excluded)

estimands.name: Secondary Estimand _ Mean Daily Steady_State Molybdenum Balance
estimands.populationSummary: Adult participants with Wilson disease at predicted ALXN1840 steady state for the 15 mg/day and 30 mg/day doses (Molybdenum Mass Balance Analysis Set (participants with evaluable molybdenum intake, dose, and output data)) Summary measure: Descriptive summary statistics of mean daily molybdenum balance by dose level; assessment of neutrality of balance (molybdenum_out equals molybdenum_in) as evidence of steady state.

intercurrentEvents.name: Dose modification, interruption, or non_escalation
intercurrentEvents.text: Dose decrease, interruption, or continuation at 15 mg/day; molybdenum balance summarized by actual dose administered

intercurrentEvents.name: Premature discontinuation of ALXN1840 (Secondary Estimand _ Mean Daily Steady_State Molybdenum Balance)
intercurrentEvents.text: Participant discontinues before the steady_state balance collection; only available while_on_treatment balance data are summarized

intercurrentEvents.name: Missed doses / non_compliance with study intervention
intercurrentEvents.text: Missed or non_adherent ALXN1840 dosing alters molybdenum intake; balance estimated as if full compliance had occurred, or intake corrected for doses actually administered

estimands.name: Secondary Estimand _ Molybdenum Accumulation
estimands.populationSummary: Adult participants with Wilson disease treated with ALXN1840 15 mg/day and 30 mg/day, in whom potential tissue (eg, hepatic) molybdenum accumulation is of interest (Molybdenum Mass Balance Analysis Set (all treated participants with evaluable molybdenum balance data)) Summary measure: Descriptive summary of net molybdenum balance (mean, SD, range) and number/proportion of participants with net positive balance indicative of accumulation, by dose level.

intercurrentEvents.name: Dose interruption or reduction
intercurrentEvents.text: Dose modification per Table 7 criteria affecting molybdenum input; all data included as observed under actual dosing

intercurrentEvents.name: Treatment discontinuation
intercurrentEvents.text: Participant discontinues ALXN1840; accumulation assessed using data collected while on treatment only

intercurrentEvents.name: Dietary molybdate variability / incomplete collections
intercurrentEvents.text: Variation in dietary molybdenum intake or incomplete excreta collection confounding the accumulation assessment; estimate derived as if diet control and complete collection had been maintained

estimands.name: Secondary Estimand _ Steady_State PK of Total and PUF_Molybdenum
estimands.populationSummary: Adult participants with Wilson disease receiving ALXN1840 with evaluable plasma PK samples at steady state for 15 mg/day and 30 mg/day (Pharmacokinetic (PK) Analysis Set (all participants who received at least 1 dose of ALXN1840 with at least 1 evaluable PK concentration)) Summary measure: Descriptive PK summary statistics by dose level (n, arithmetic and geometric mean, %CV, median, minimum, maximum); dose proportionality assessed descriptively between 15 mg and 30 mg.

intercurrentEvents.name: Dose modification or non_escalation to 30 mg/day (Secondary Estimand _ Steady_State PK of Total and PUF_Molybdenum)
intercurrentEvents.text: Dose reduction, interruption, or remaining on 15 mg/day; PK parameters summarized according to the dose actually administered at the time of sampling

intercurrentEvents.name: Emesis, missed dose, or PK sampling deviation
intercurrentEvents.text: Vomiting after dosing, missed dose, or protocol deviation in PK sample timing/handling rendering profiles non_evaluable; PK estimated as if dosing and sampling had occurred per protocol (non_evaluable profiles excluded)

intercurrentEvents.name: Treatment discontinuation before steady_state PK profile
intercurrentEvents.text: Participant discontinues ALXN1840 prior to the steady_state PK assessment; only on_treatment PK data are summarized

estimands.name: Safety Estimand _ Safety and Tolerability of Repeat_Dose ALXN1840
estimands.populationSummary: Adult participants with Wilson disease who received at least 1 dose of ALXN1840 (15 mg/day and/or 30 mg/day) (Safety Analysis Set (all participants who received at least 1 dose of ALXN1840)) Summary measure: Descriptive summaries: number and percentage of participants with TEAEs/SAEs by MedDRA system organ class and preferred term, severity and relationship; descriptive statistics and change from baseline for laboratory, ECG, and vital sign parameters; shift tables for clinically significant abnormalities.

intercurrentEvents.name: Dose reduction or interruption due to meeting dose modification criteria
intercurrentEvents.text: ALXN1840 dose decreased (down to 15 mg every other day) or interrupted per dose modification criteria; all safety events are attributed to and included under the treatment received

intercurrentEvents.name: Permanent discontinuation of ALXN1840 due to adverse event
intercurrentEvents.text: Discontinuation of study intervention due to a TEAE/SAE is itself captured as a safety outcome and included in the analysis

intercurrentEvents.name: Use of concomitant or rescue medications
intercurrentEvents.text: Use of concomitant medications (including reintroduction of chelator therapy) to manage adverse events; all safety data are included regardless of concomitant medication use

estimands.name: Exploratory Estimand _ Dose Response of ALXN1840 on Copper Balance
estimands.populationSummary: Adult participants with Wilson disease who received both ALXN1840 15 mg/day and 30 mg/day with evaluable copper balance collections at each dose (Full Analysis Set (within_participant dose comparison; participants with evaluable copper balance at both dose levels)) Summary measure: Descriptive within_participant difference in mean daily copper balance between 30 mg/day and 15 mg/day; graphical/exploratory dose_response characterization.

intercurrentEvents.name: No escalation to 30 mg/day
intercurrentEvents.text: Participant remains on ALXN1840 15 mg/day due to safety concerns and therefore contributes no 30 mg/day data; dose_response estimated among participants who received both doses

intercurrentEvents.name: Dose reduction or interruption during a collection period
intercurrentEvents.text: Dose modification during the 15 mg/day or 30 mg/day collection periods; data analyzed as observed according to actual dose received

intercurrentEvents.name: Treatment discontinuation before the 30 mg/day collection period
intercurrentEvents.text: Participant discontinues ALXN1840 before the 30 mg/day periods (Days 31_35 and Days 36_39); only available on_treatment data are used

estimands.name: Exploratory Estimand _ Effect of Treatment Duration on Copper Balance
estimands.populationSummary: Adult participants with Wilson disease with copper balance assessments across multiple collection periods over the first 40 days of ALXN1840 treatment (Full Analysis Set (all treated participants with at least two evaluable copper balance collection periods)) Summary measure: Descriptive summary of mean daily copper balance by collection period over time, with within_participant differences between accumulation and steady_state periods.

intercurrentEvents.name: Extension of the Outpatient Period
intercurrentEvents.text: Outpatient Period (Day 9 to Day 23) extended by up to 14 additional days, or check_in on Day 22 instead of Day 23, altering the nominal timing of collection periods; actual elapsed treatment duration is used in the time_course analysis

intercurrentEvents.name: Non_adherence to copper_controlled diet during Outpatient Period
intercurrentEvents.text: Participants are encouraged but not required to remain on a copper_controlled diet while outpatient; a diet equilibration period is included in each study period, and the time effect is estimated as if diet control had been maintained

intercurrentEvents.name: Premature discontinuation of ALXN1840 (Exploratory Estimand _ Effect of Treatment Duration on Copper Balance)
intercurrentEvents.text: Participant discontinues study intervention before later collection periods; only observed on_treatment periods contribute to the time_course assessment

estimands.name: Exploratory Estimand _ Ceruloplasmin, Ceruloplasmin_Bound Copper, and LBC
estimands.populationSummary: Adult participants with Wilson disease treated with ALXN1840 with evaluable plasma copper speciation samples (Full Analysis Set (all treated participants with baseline/predose and at least one post_dose ceruloplasmin or copper speciation assessment)) Summary measure: Descriptive summary statistics of absolute values and change from predose in ceruloplasmin, ceruloplasmin_bound copper, and LBC by nominal visit and dose level.

intercurrentEvents.name: Dose modification or non_escalation to 30 mg/day (Exploratory Estimand _ Ceruloplasmin, Ceruloplasmin_Bound Copper, and LBC)
intercurrentEvents.text: Dose reduction, interruption, or continuation at 15 mg/day; biomarker results summarized by actual dose received at the time of sampling

intercurrentEvents.name: Reinitiation of chelator or zinc therapy (Exploratory Estimand _ Ceruloplasmin, Ceruloplasmin_Bound Copper, and LBC)
intercurrentEvents.text: Use of prohibited copper_modifying background/rescue therapy confounding plasma copper speciation; results estimated as if such therapy had not been used

intercurrentEvents.name: Treatment discontinuation or missed biomarker sampling
intercurrentEvents.text: Participant discontinues ALXN1840 or misses scheduled Day 1/8/25/29/36/39 sampling; only available on_treatment assessments are summarized with no imputation

Active hepatitis B or C or HIV seropositivity
Significant history of systemic or psychiatric disorders
Use of experimental or unapproved therapy
Known sensitivity to ALXN1840 or excipients
Recent alcohol consumption or positive breath test
Unwilling to complete controlled menu meals

population.name: Study Population
population.description: Participants aged ≥18 years with a diagnosis of Wilson Disease who may benefit from decoppering therapy

biospecimenRetentions.name: Retained Serum Sample for Unexpected Safety Findings
biospecimenRetentions.description: A single 15 mL serum sample will be collected at check_in and retained for evaluation in the event of an unexpected safety finding; retained samples may be destroyed after completion of the clinical study report. No genetic/DNA testing of retained samples is described in the protocol.

notes.text: Medical Monitor Name and Contact Information can be found in the Study Contact List.

This amendment is considered to be substantial based on the criteria set forth in Article 10(a) of Directive 2001/20/EC of the European Parliament and the Council of the European Union, the US Food and Drug Administration's (FDA) regulation at 21 CFR part 312.30(b), and any applicable local regulations.

Overall Rationale for the Amendment: The main reason for preparation of this amendment was to clarify study procedures occurring across different sites in the US, so as to facilitate participant recruitment across different regions of the US, and to lessen inconvenience for participants without compromising the quality of the study.
Addition of text to the footnote to state that procedures specific to screening sites (only in the US) detailed in Section 8. Rationale: As per Section 8 (below).

Number of days changed from 30 days to 21 days: 'However, the physiologic turnover of human gastrointestinal epithelial cells is 3_5 days (Darwich, 2014); therefore, the inhibitory effect of zinc on intestinal copper absorption is expected to be minimal 21 days after discontinuation of zinc.' Rationale: To align the number of days with the mention of zinc discontinuation elsewhere in the protocol.

Addition of text applicable only to the US that details the possibility for sites in the US to only perform screening procedures and not any of the remaining study procedures. Rationale: To facilitate participant recruitment across different regions of the US and to lessen inconvenience for participants without compromising the quality of the study.
Abbreviations: ALT = alanine aminotransferase; AST = aspartate aminotransferase; IB = Investigator's Brochure; PK = pharmacokinetics; WD = Wilson disease.

The COVID_19 pandemic is active at the time of this protocol amendment. Given this unique circumstance, specific consideration has been given to the potential risks and mitigation measures due to COVID_19 vaccine (see Section 10.5).

Blood draws are optimized for PK. A cannula may be placed to minimize needle sticks; however, a catheter may not be left in place for longer than 72 hours and should be flushed a minimum of every 8 hours.
In the event that items cannot be accurately quantified, items may be balanced during pretreatment period and post_treatment period to support the change from baseline assessment.
Participants will be strongly encouraged to void within 2 hours of completion of each 24_hour period (ie, dosing time).

To ensure flexibility, the Outpatient Period during Treatment Period 1 may be extended up to an additional 14 days with Investigator approval. In such cases, the actual Outpatient Period duration will be recorded and the participant will continue Inpatient Period 2 at Day 23.
At the CRU's discretion, participants may remain in the CRU during the outpatient period for safety or to maintain the integrity of the conduct of the study.

This study incorporates the use of an adaptive design. Adaptive features may be implemented at the discretion of the Investigator to support conduct of the study. Such adaptive features do not require amendment of the protocol.
Dose range limit 15 mg every other day to 30 mg/day; Outpatient Period extension not >14 days; check_in to clinical research unit allowed 1 day prior.

Acetaminophen should be limited to 1000 mg/day. Herbal remedies must be discontinued at least 7 days prior to first admission until study completion. Over_the_counter medications may be given if they are not expected to impact the outcome of the study.
Abbreviations: CRF = case report form; CRU = clinical research unit; EOS = End of Study; SoA = Schedule of Activities.
Rescreened participants are not required to reconsent as long as they have signed the latest version of the ICF.
If the study intervention is definitively discontinued, the participant should remain in the study to be evaluated for safety follow_up.
This review of the ECG printed at the time of collection must be documented. Any new clinically relevant finding should be reported as an AE.

Blood pressure and heart rate measurements should be preceded by at least 5 minutes of rest for the participant in a quiet setting without distractions (eg, television, cell phones). Ideally, the same arm for each participant should be used for measurements.

If vital signs are abnormal as defined by inclusion/exclusion criteria, 2 additional vital signs measurements will be made. The average of the 3 vital signs measurements will be recorded in the CRF and used to determine participant eligibility.
As with vital signs, if ECG interval measurements are abnormal, an additional triplicate will be performed and recorded in the CRF.

All laboratory tests with values considered abnormal and clinically significant during participation in the study or after the last dose of study intervention should be repeated until the values return to normal or baseline or are no longer considered clinically significant by the Investigator or Medical Monitor.

All SAEs will be recorded and reported to Alexion or the designee immediately and under no circumstance should this exceed 24 hours, as indicated in Section 10.3. The Investigator will submit any updated SAE data to Alexion within 24 hours of it being available.

Investigators are not obligated to actively seek AE or SAE data after conclusion of the study participation. However, if the Investigator learns of any SAE, including a death, at any time after a participant has been discharged from the study, and he/she considers the event to be reasonably related to the study intervention or study participation, the Investigator must promptly notify Alexion.
Care will be taken not to introduce bias when detecting AEs and/or SAEs. Open_ended and non_leading verbal questioning of the participant is the preferred method to inquire about AE occurrences.
There are no adverse events of special interest for this study.

A single biobanked serum sample will be collected predose from each participant to serve as a retained sample during the study. Samples will remain on site and will be discarded following the completion of the clinical study report. The sample will not be used for genetic testing (see Section 8.7).

For this study, any dose of ALXN1840 greater than that specified in the protocol will be considered an overdose. Overdoses are medication errors that are not considered AEs unless there is an untoward medical occurrence resulting from the overdose.
Samples collected within ± 10% or 30 min, whichever is less, of the scheduled time will not be considered a protocol deviation.

Excess/additional samples may be stored for up to 5 years and used for PD and/or diagnostic biomarker development and research to understand the pathways associated with the mechanism of action of ALXN1840. These samples will not be used for genetic analyses (ie, RNA or DNA analyses). Genetic analyses will not be performed on these whole blood samples. Participant confidentiality will be maintained.
Genetics will not be evaluated in this study.
Immunogenicity Assessments: Not applicable.
Health economic and medical resource utilization parameters are not evaluated in this study.
As this study is an exploratory study, no formal hypothesis testing is being conducted. Study results will be summarized using descriptive statistics.
The sample size will be approximately 10 participants which will allow a general characterization of copper balance in response to ALXN1840.
Enrolled: All participants who sign the ICF, are eligible for the study, and are registered on Day _7 when participants are assigned a participant number.
Alexion Confidential — appears in the footer of every page of the protocol.

I have read the study protocol amendment 3.1 and agree to conduct the study in accordance with this protocol, all applicable government regulations, the principles of the ICH E6 Guidelines for Good Clinical Practice, and the principles of the World Medical Association Declaration of Helsinki. I also agree to maintain the confidentiality of all information received or developed in connection with this protocol.

studyInterventions.name: ALXN1840
studyInterventions.description: ALXN1840 (bis_choline tetrathiomolybdate; formerly WTX101), a novel copper_binding agent given orally once daily as 15 mg/day for approximately 28 days followed by titration to 30 mg/day on Day 29 through Day 39 in participants with Wilson disease; single_arm, open_label, repeat_dose

studyInterventions.name: Paracetamol/acetaminophen
studyInterventions.description: Permitted as an exception with Investigator approval at a maximum of 1000 mg/day

studyInterventions.name: Ibuprofen
studyInterventions.description: Permitted with caution (CYP2C9 substrate); dose must not exceed 1200 mg in any 24_hour period and requires Investigator approval

studyInterventions.name: Other concomitant medications / nonprescription (over_the_counter) medications
studyInterventions.description: May be used during the study if deemed medically indicated by the Investigator and not expected to impact study outcome; all medications, vaccines, vitamins and herbal supplements taken from 14 days prior to enrollment (Day _7) through End of Study must be recorded

studyInterventions.name: Prescription and nonprescription medications (including vitamins, dietary and herbal supplement
studyInterventions.description: Prohibited: participants must abstain from prescription medications within 14 days or 5 half_lives (whichever is longer) of Day _7, and nonprescription drugs/vitamins/dietary or herbal supplements within 7 days or 5 half_lives (whichever is longer) before Day _7 until completion of the follow_up visit, except paracetamol/acetaminophen and ibuprofen as specified

studyInterventions.name: St John's wort (herbal remedy or dietary supplement containing St John's wor
studyInterventions.description: Prohibited from 2 weeks before first study intervention administration until after the End of Study Visit; herbal remedies must be discontinued at least 7 days prior to first admission

studyInterventions.name: CYP2C9 and CYP2B6 substrates
studyInterventions.description: Caution required with coadministration of drugs known to be substrates of CYP2C9 and CYP2B6

studyInterventions.name: Copper_chelating therapy (penicillamine or trientin
studyInterventions.description: Prior therapy requiring washout: participants taking chelation therapy must discontinue starting on Day _4 (approximately 4 days) before initiation of ALXN1840 to allow baseline copper/molybdenum balance assessment

studyInterventions.name: Zinc therapy
studyInterventions.description: Prior therapy requiring washout: must be discontinued a minimum of 21 days prior to Day 1 (discontinued at Day _21); previous zinc treatment within 21 days prior to Day 1 is exclusionary

studyInterventions.name: Minerals/supplements containing copper, zinc, or molybdenum
Tetrathiomolybdate (other forms) / prior ALXN1840
studyInterventions.description: Prohibited: previous treatment with ALXN1840 or other form of tetrathiomolybdate within 1 year prior to dosing is exclusionary

studyInterventions.name: Experimental or unapproved/unlicensed therapy
studyInterventions.description: Prohibited within 90 days or 5 half_lives (whichever is longer) prior to Screening Visit

studyInterventions.name: Copper_ and molybdenum_controlled diet
studyInterventions.description: Standardized copper_ and molybdenum_controlled meals and controlled fluid intake (minimum 1.5 L water/day) provided during Inpatient Period 1 (Day _8 to Day 9) and Inpatient Period 2 (Day 23 to Day 40); usual copper_controlled diet encouraged during Outpatient Period
